sim_truth: synthetic banks sim_chain (floor 1/9, depths 1-6) and sim_brew (floor 1/4, depths 1-5), 120 pairs/depth; kf mu = 0.5 + 0.8 log2 N, beta 1.1; key-last shift Delta = max(0, 1.6 - 0.3 log2 N), r = 1; shared item effect sd 0.6. Truth: Delta_m and the ratio fall with log N (negative slopes; Delta_m slope ≈ -0.43 per unit ln N until it hits 0), r slope 0, kl:dep:logN ≈ 0 in logit space.

pooled.formula: y ~ C(bank) * (kl + dep + logN + kl:dep + kl:logN + dep:logN) + kl:dep:logN
